name: wadar
description: WADAR — asisten bisnis AI untuk UMKM Indonesia (monorepo)

scripts.db:generate: for f in modules/*/drizzle.config.ts; do pnpm exec drizzle-kit generate --config="$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.db:migrate: for f in modules/*/drizzle.config.ts; do pnpm exec drizzle-kit migrate --config="$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.db:push: for f in modules/*/drizzle.config.ts; do pnpm exec drizzle-kit push --config="$f" --force || exit 1; done
scripts.db:grant: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec -T postgres psql -U wadar -d wadar -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/02-grant-and-force-rls.sql
scripts.evals: echo "no evals yet — mulai M8 (lihat docs/BUILD-PLAN.md)" && exit 0
